blocks.prompt: 17 If \(2 + x, 5 + x\) and \(9 + x\) are in H.P., find the value of \(x\).
blocks.explanation:
Teen expressions H.P. mein hain, to darmiyani \(5 + x\) baqi do ka H.M. hai. Is se \(x\) ki ek equation banti hai.
Achhi khabar: dekhne mein quadratic lagegi lekin \(x^{2}\) wali terms kat jayengi aur simple equation bachegi.
Plan: H.M. ki shart likho, cross-multiply, kholo, hal karo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2 + x, 5 + x, 9 + x\) H.P. mein.
Humein find karna hai: \(x\).
Tareeqa: Darmiyani term = H.M. = \(\frac{2 \times \text{pehli} \times \text{teesri}}{\text{pehli} + \text{teesri}}\). (Doosra raasta: reciprocals ko A.P. maan kar \(\frac{2}{5 + x} = \frac{1}{2 + x} + \frac{1}{9 + x}\); dono ek hi equation dete hain.)

Cross-multiply
\[(5 + x)(11 + 2x) = 2(2 + x)(9 + x)\]
Kyun: Fraction hatane ke liye dono taraf \((11 + 2x)\) se multiply kiya.

Dono taraf kholein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = 55 + 21x + 2x^{2}\]
\[\text{R.H.S.} = 2(18 + 11x + x^{2})\]
\[= 36 + 22x + 2x^{2}\]
Kyun: Har bracket ki har term ko doosre ki har term se multiply: \(5 \times 11 = 55\), \(5 \times 2x = 10x\), \(x \times 11 = 11x\), \(x \times 2x = 2x^{2}\). Right side par pehle \((2 + x)(9 + x)\) khola, phir 2 se multiply.
Dhyan dein: Right side ka 2 teeno terms ko multiply karta hai, sirf pehli ko nahi.

Hal karein
\[55 + 21x = 36 + 22x\]
\[x = 19\]
Kyun: \(2x^{2}\) dono taraf hai, kat gaya. Phir \(55 - 36 = 22x - 21x\), yani \(19 = x\).

Tasdeeq: \(x = 19\) se numbers 21, 24, 28 bante hain. Reciprocals:
\[\dfrac{1}{24} - \dfrac{1}{21} = -\dfrac{1}{168}\]
\[\dfrac{1}{28} - \dfrac{1}{24} = -\dfrac{1}{168} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Farq barabar hai, to reciprocals A.P. mein aur numbers H.P. mein hain. Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab nahi diya gaya.
